states: Private mock stack built from this tree (backend :7701, Vite :5221, 3 nodes, 31 Proxmox guests) with five guests already carrying saved web-interface URLs.

Guests table header shows an 'Edit links' action beside the guest count at 1280, 1024 and 375 widths without horizontal overflow; it opens a right-hand panel listing all 31 guests in the filtered view, name-sorted, each with type, ID and node, the saved URL or an IP-based placeholder, and a label tied to its input.

Node-scoped view (Show guests on West Production B) limits the editor to that node's 8 guests; the 'Without a link' filter shows the 25 guests with no saved link, including one whose link was just removed.
Phone 375x812: full-height sheet, name above a 44px input, footer pinned, no horizontal overflow (dark theme). Light theme checked at 1280.

Invalid entry 'auth14 admin page' blocked the whole save with the shared validator's message on that row and aria-invalid; native browser URL validation is disabled so Pulse's message shows. GET /api/guests/metadata confirmed nothing was written.

Valid save of one addition, one correction and one removal wrote all three through PUT /api/guests/metadata, showed 'Saved 3 links.', closed the panel, returned focus to the trigger, and the table link icons updated without reload. This is not physical-device, vSphere-estate or release acceptance.

Re-checked after renaming the row-reuse helper (identifier only): the editor opened with 31 rows, a draft survived three seconds of live ticks, and submitting saved docs-wiki-01 through PUT /api/guests/metadata and closed the panel.
interactions: Clicked Edit links; typed into three inputs over several live inventory ticks without losing focus or values; footer counted 3 unsaved changes and the trigger showed (unsaved).
Pressed Enter to submit with one invalid value, corrected it, pressed Enter again; toggled All / Without a link; closed via the header button and reopened.
Selected a node's guests from the nodes table, then reopened the editor to confirm scope follows the table filter.
